warnings: Row B, grid2-3 (segment B2-B3): no beam mark or double-line beam symbol is printed on this edge, even though both B2 and B3 carry columns/footings — the 'S0' bay east of grid2 (rows C-B) appears open at its south edge, unlike its north edge (C2-C3='B2') and its two sides (grid2='B4', grid3='B1'). Left unrecorded rather than inventing a mark; treated as a genuine gap, not a miss.

ROW D-C VERTICALS, re-read at high zoom after Makham flagged a missing beam (2026-08-26). This strip carries FIVE vertical beams and NONE of them sits on grid1 or grid3: B1 on 1' (the balcony/west edge, between the two CN1 tie-columns), B6 on 2' (east side of the stair opening), B1 on grid2, B1 on 2" (west edge of the dropped S2 bay), B1 on 3' (east edge). Grid1 and grid3 carry only their dash-dot centrelines here — the stair opening occupies grid1-2', and the S2 bay spans 2"-3' straight past grid3. An earlier pass recorded the 1' and 3' beams as 'D1-C1' and 'D3-C3' and missed the 2' beam entirely. Pixel-scanned centrelines (scale 78.70 px/m, calibrated on grid1-grid2 = 3.50m and E-A = 10.70m): 1' = -1.00, 2' = +2.25, grid2 = +3.50, 2" = +4.70, 3' = +6.90, all measured east of grid1. Note grid1 and grid3 DO carry beams in the E-D, C-B and B-A strips — the gap is specific to D-C.

'B6' (small beam east of the stair) is on dummy line 2': no printed dimension locates it, but its west face measures exactly on the stair opening's east edge and its centreline scans at 2.25m east of grid1. Upgraded from the earlier '~D1-2 / ~C1-2' approximation to a resolved grid_ref against the new dummy; its section is on S-15/หน้า42 and reads 0.25x0.40, 3ø16มม top AND bottom, tie ø6มม@0.075 — an earlier note here said 0.20x0.40 with tie @0.15, which was wrong on both counts. B6 is the only 0.25m-wide beam in the house.

'CN1' (small 0.20x0.20 tie-column, 4-Ø12mm, X-hatch symbol) sits on D1' and C1' — on the west balcony edge line, NOT on grid D1/C1 as an earlier pass recorded. The hatched squares on grid D1/C1 are the main columns C9 (footing plans S-02/S-03), drawn with the ordinary diagonal-hatch symbol; CN1's X-hatch squares are 1.10m further west and are what the two B3X stubs and the D1'-C1' edge beam frame into. So CN1 is a SEPARATE small tie-column carrying the balcony edge, not the same physical column as C9 continuing upward. Its spec is recorded once in the S-13 section file (per S-13/หน้า40: 'เสา CN1 ขึ้นจากขั้น1-ถึงชานพัก') and it is not re-listed as a plan element here.

'SP' markers with a direction arrow appear once per room bay (E-D and D-C, C-B, B-A bays) — these indicate precast solid-plank (SOLID PLANK) span direction per S-01's notes item 4, not a distinct member mark. Not itemized individually as elements; the plank system itself is documented under the S1/S2/S0 slab entries and the SP-laying details on S-19/S-20.
